一夜无事，王野早早的就起来了。现在已经养成习惯了，王野还有点怀念前世的生活。

吃过早饭王野就骑车回老家了，这也就是小丫头没有周末的概念，要是知道王野休息不在家跟他玩，自己跑了那就热闹了。

一路无事王野在进村之前从空间里取出了二十斤大米，二十斤白面，和五十斤玉米面装在三个面袋子里。又从空间中取出一盒点心，一袋奶粉，两瓶水果罐头，两瓶肉罐头和一斤水果糖，放进背篓里。

王野直接骑车来爷爷家的院子。一进门就见全家都在，似乎在商量什么事儿。看见王野进门所有人都看向王野，奶奶赶紧站起来三步并作两步迎了上去。满脸宠溺的说：“诶呦喂，我大孙子回来了。”

王野笑嘻嘻的说：“奶奶，这不是休息吗，我回来看看你们。”

说完赶紧把车子支起来，从后架上取下粮食说：“奶奶，这是我带的粮食。咱先放屋里去吧。”

奶奶赶紧叫道：“老二老三，赶紧把我大孙子带的东西搬屋里去。”

说完就拉着王野坐在小凳子上。王野一一和家人打过招呼后问道：“爷爷，你们刚才干什么呢，商量什么事儿吗？”

王爷爷叹了口气说：“咳，还不是粮食闹得。”

王野说：“咱家缺粮食了？”

王爷爷说：“不是咱家，是你二婶家。你二婶他娘已经绝食两天了。”

王野直接愣住了心想：“现在老太太这么叛逆吗？还绝食。”

二婶在一边不停的抽噎。王爷爷继续说：“亲家母也是没办法了，就想着给小一辈儿的留点吃食儿。”

王野直接就被这个结论震惊到了，磕磕巴巴的问：“那......那就要把自己饿死呀？”

二婶抽噎的说：“我大哥，在我娘床前跪了一天了，她就是不吃。”

王野又问爷爷说：“爷爷，现在已经到这种地步了吗？”

王爷爷叹了口气说：“难呀，咱们村子还好一点，地里的庄稼虽然要减产了，可是还有个盼头。你二婶他们村是真的要绝产了。”

王野说：“这也不是个办法呀，上面就没有什么补救措施。”

王爷爷怒气冲冲的说：“公社那群王八......”

太爷爷咳嗽一声打断了王爷爷的话皱着眉头说：“瞎说什么，嘴上没个把门的，这么大岁数活狗身上去了。”

王爷爷尴尬的一笑说：“爹，这不是跟我大孙子说吗？”

太爷爷没好气儿说：“不知道隔墙有耳呀。”

王爷爷哦了一声也不说了，王野说：“那你们商量出个什么结果吗？”

王爷爷说：“能有什么结果呀，让你二婶从咱家拿点粮食回去呗，还能怎么办呀。”

王野想了想说：“爷爷，咱家也不差那点儿粮食。我这次又带回来了一些。要说给太多不太现实，但是养个老太太还不成问题。”

王野进屋拎出了那袋玉米面说：“爷爷，这是五十斤玉米面，你看这样行不，二婶和三婶家一家给十五斤，咱也不要厚此薄彼。

After a peaceful night, Wang Ye got up early.Now that he has formed a habit, Wang Ye still misses his previous life.

After breakfast, Wang Ye rode back to his hometown. This means that the little girl has no concept of weekends. It would be hilarious if she knew that Wang Ye was not at home to play with him and ran away by herself.

The journey was uneventful. Before entering the village, Wang Ye took out 20 kilograms of rice, 20 kilograms of white flour, and 50 kilograms of cornmeal from the space and put them into three flour bags.He also took out a box of snacks, a bag of milk powder, two bottles of canned fruit, two bottles of canned meat and a pound of fruit candies from the space, and put them into the backpack.

Wang Ye rode directly to his grandfather's yard.As soon as I walked in, I saw the whole family there, seeming to be discussing something.Seeing Wang Ye entering the door, everyone looked at Wang Ye. Grandma quickly stood up and took three steps at a time to meet him.He said with a doting look on his face: "Hey, my eldest grandson is back."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Grandma, isn't this a break? I'll come back to see you."

After saying that, he quickly put the car up, took the grain from the rear rack and said, "Grandma, this is the grain I brought. Let's put it in the house first."

Grandma quickly shouted: "Second and third brother, please move the things my eldest grandson brought into the house quickly."

After saying that, he pulled Wang Ye to sit on the small stool.Wang Ye greeted his family members one by one and asked: "Grandpa, what were you doing just now? Did you discuss anything?"

Grandpa Wang sighed and said, "Well, it's not the food that's causing the trouble."

Wang Ye said: "Our family is short of food?"

Grandpa Wang said: "It's not our house, it's your second aunt's house. Your second aunt has been on a hunger strike for two days."

Wang Ye was stunned and thought: "Is the old lady so rebellious now? She is still on a hunger strike."

The second aunt kept sobbing on the side.Grandpa Wang continued: "My mother-in-law had no choice but to leave some food for the younger generation."

Wang Ye was immediately shocked by this conclusion, and asked stumblingly: "Then...are you going to starve yourself to death?"

The second aunt sobbed and said, "My eldest brother has been kneeling in front of my mother's bed for a whole day, and she just won't eat."

Wang Ye asked his grandfather again: "Grandpa, has it reached this point now?"

Grandpa Wang sighed and said, "It's difficult. Our village is a little better. Although the crops in the fields are about to decrease, there is still hope. Your second aunt and their village are really going to die out."

Wang Ye said: "This is not a solution. There are no remedies from above."

Grandpa Wang said angrily: "Those bastards in the commune..."

Great Grandpa coughed and interrupted Grandpa Wang. He frowned and said, "What nonsense are you talking about? You don't know what to say. You're so old and you're dead on a dog."

Grandpa Wang smiled awkwardly and said, "Dad, aren't you talking to my eldest grandson?"

Grandpa said angrily: "I didn't know that walls have ears."

Grandpa Wang said nothing, and Wang Ye said, "What will be the result of your discussion?"

Grandpa Wang said: "What can be the result? Let your second aunt bring some food back from our house. What else can we do?"

Wang Ye thought for a moment and said, "Grandpa, our family doesn't lack that much food. I brought some back this time. It's unrealistic to say it's too much, but raising an old lady is not a problem."

Wang Ye went into the house and took out the bag of cornmeal and said, "Grandpa, this is fifty kilograms of cornmeal. Do you think this will work? The second and third aunts will give fifteen kilograms to each family. Let's not favor one over the other."
